original_six_point_corner.state: Geometric proof written and internally checked; independent finite function-field tests executed.
original_six_point_corner.statement: Q=w_2/w_1 is independent of L0 up to row/column scaling. The actual L1-coordinate matrix of the first three points, with the last three as coordinate points, is the transpose of the entrywise reciprocal Q. On the general-position locus the finite corner is the classical corner of these same six points.
original_six_point_corner.consequence: The eighteen-coefficient and eleven-factor conditions are exactly the L1 general-position conditions. The extra first coefficient series may vanish without affecting this corner.
original_six_point_corner.prior_identity: The elliptic Cauchy/Frobenius determinant identity is known. The manuscript proves the particular coefficient/coordinate identification directly rather than claiming that identity as new.

ample_helix_reconstruction.hypotheses: Hom-finite noetherian abelian target of finite homological dimension; an AZ-ample structure pair with higher-Ext tail vanishing; a full very strong periodic helix containing the structure object and with the specified period.
ample_helix_reconstruction.statement: The helix objects belong to the target heart. Dimension shifting proves ampleness of their direct sum. Artin-Zhang/Polishchuk reconstruction gives the right-noetherian orbit algebra and identifies qgr with the target heart. A direct graded-ideal proof of right noetherianity is included.
ample_helix_reconstruction.safeguard: A merely full strong collection is not silently assumed very strong; no noetherian conclusion is inferred from a finite corner alone.

normalized_abelian_comparison.statement: B(W+) is right noetherian and the specified normalized dg functor Psi+ is t-exact. Hence AS+ and anticanonical hearts agree here; right noetherianity and Delta nonvanishing need not be additional independent assumptions on this common locus.

normalized_abelian_comparison.limitation: Not every potential, singular boundary, arbitrary full strong collection, or unchanged printed AOU presentation. No relative-heart descent claimed.
